propositions: Project code-review criteria declared in a repository overlay were dropped at five seams: criterion-id resolver, Round-A fan-in, Pass-3 routing, eval/calibration, and CLI admission.
The four-pass code-review system must thread project criteria through each seam so an active project criterion runs once in Round A while retaining its logical criteria id and physical reviewer_id.
Pass-3 routing must be repository-effective while the no-overlay runtime preserves the ordered 13 built-ins, packaged dispositions, and default plan-review resolver mapping.
Eval/calibration API and CLI must admit an active code-review-only project criterion and reject inactive or ambiguous project ids.
The project-criterion runtime contract must be documented and the first criterion project.review-phase-boundaries authored with a balanced eval corpus.
The criterion is dogfooded in advisory-only live Gerrit reviews with blocking disabled and routing threshold 0.90.
